    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AlgorithmMovement
    Utility class that calculates the movement direction of NonPlayable enemies in relation to the player character.
    AlgorithmMovementRange
    Utility class that calculates the movement and attack direction of NonPlayable enemies with ranged attack capabilities relative to the player.
    Armes
    Abstract class representing a weapon equipment.
    AttackCollisions
    Utility class to handle attack collision detection between a player and enemies.
    Bat
    Class representing a Bat enemy in the game.
    BouclierBois
    Represents a wooden shield ("Bouclier en bois") that can be equipped by the player.
    BulletCollisions
    Utility class to handle collision detection for bullets.
    Bullets
    Abstract class representing a projectile (bullet, fireball, arrow, etc.) fired by an entity in the game.
    Coeur
    Class representing the "Heart" healing item.
    CoeurMax
    Class representing the "MaxHeart" healing item.
    CollisionDistance
    Utility class for checking collision distances between the player and other entities.
    CollisionEquipement
    Utility class for detecting collisions between a player and equipment items.
    Collisions
    Utility class for detecting collisions between players.
    CollisionsMap
    Utility class for handling collision detection between the player and the game map.
    CollisionsNpcMap
    Utility class for handling collision detection between NPCs (NonPlayable characters) and the game map.
    CreationMonstres
    Utility class for handling the creation or spawning of monsters (NonPlayable characters) on the game map.
    DropItems
    Utility class for dropping items in the game.
    EpeeBois
    Represents a wooden sword (“Épée en bois”), a basic melee weapon.
    Equipements
    Abstract class representing an equipment item in the game.
    GamePanel
    The main game panel class that handles the game loop, rendering, and updates.
    Gumba
    Class representing a Gumba enemy in the game.
    JeanGuy
    Class representing the playable character "JeanGuy".
    KeyHandler
    Handles keyboard input for the game.
    Main
     
    Marchand
    Class representing the NPC "Marchand" (merchant) in the game.
    MaskGuy
    Class representing a specific type of non-playable character (NPC) called "MaskGuy".
    NonPlayable
    Abstract class representing a non-playable character (NPC) in the game.
    Octorok
    Class representing the "Octorok" non-playable character (NPC).
    Octorokatk
    Subclass of the super class Bullet.
    Odette
    Class representing the NPC "Odette" in the game.
    Panel
     
    Playable
    Abstract class representing a playable character in the game.
    Players
    Abstract class representing a player or non-player character in the game.
    Soins
    Abstract class representing healing items in the game.
    Tile
    Represents a single tile in the game world.
    TileManager
    Manages all the tiles in the game, including loading images, keeping track of map layout, and rendering tiles on the screen.
    UI
    The UI class handles all user interface elements in the game.
